final: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS matched_orders FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, matched_orders, 1.0 * matched_orders / SUM(matched_orders) OVER () AS share_of_total, 1.0 * matched_orders * COUNT(*) OVER () / SUM(matched_orders) OVER () AS count_over_average FROM scope_counts ORDER BY scope
